title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend (Part 1) crosses Rs 1,000 crore worldwide gross in 8 days (Rs 1,033.55 cr to 12 Nov, Sacnilk estimate); 11th Indian film past Rs 1,000 cr, third-fastest
headline: Ramayana Crosses ₹1,000 Crore Worldwide in 8 Days
caption:
Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, Part 1 of Nitesh Tiwari's two-film Ramayana, has crossed ₹1,000 crore at the worldwide box office in its first eight days in cinemas, to Thursday 12 November. Trade tracker Sacnilk estimates its worldwide gross at ₹1,033.55 crore.

That is ₹675.05 crore gross from India and about ₹358.5 crore from overseas, which Sacnilk calls a rough estimate. India net collections stand at ₹564.6 crore. The makers have not confirmed these figures.

It is the 11th Indian film to pass ₹1,000 crore worldwide, and the third-fastest. Only Pushpa 2: The Rule and Dhurandhar: The Revenge got there within a week; Baahubali 2 took 10 days and RRR 16.

Sources: Sacnilk, ETV Bharat, BizAsia, Film Companion
